newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish LOT cuts fares for holiday flyers.
newsitem.headline: Polish LOT cuts fares for holiday flyers.

text.p: Poland's national airlines PLL LOT SA will lower ticket prices, from May 31 to August 31, on many European routes in line with its summer holiday programme, a LOT official said on Monday.
The programme is designed to encourage airplane-shy Poles to take advantage of air travel by slashing ticket prices to between $119-$309 from previous lowest prices of $143-$434.

"The domestic market is small as few Poles fly. We want to increase demand for flying and show that airplane tickets are not as expensive as Poles think," LOT's trade director Krzysztof Ziebinski told a news conference.

He said LOT had also made code-sharing agreements with Italy's Alitalia and France's Air France, which would reduce the attraction of third-airline transfer flights between Poland and Italy and Poland and France.
